walkthroughs.body_html:
The Cold War in Asia 1945-93 — a core area of A-Level History.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

The Cold War in Asia 1945-93 brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with The Cold War in Asia 1945-93.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Who led the communists to victory in China in 1949?
options: Mao Zedong
Chiang Kai-shek
Ho Chi Minh
Kim Il-sung

mcqs.q: How did the Korean War of 1950-53 end?
options: In stalemate near the original border
With a communist conquest of all Korea
With US occupation of China
With Korean unification

mcqs.q: What did the Domino Theory predict?
options: Communism would spread country by country if unchecked
The USSR would invade the USA
China would become capitalist
Korea would unite peacefully

mcqs.q: What was significant about Nixon's 1972 visit to China?
options: It eased hostility between the USA and China
It started the Korean War
It united North and South Vietnam
It ended the Cold War
China conquered Vietnam in the war.
Communist North Vietnam ultimately won, reuniting the country in 1975 after US forces had withdrawn, despite massive American intervention.
China and the USA were allies throughout the Cold War.
The USA won the Vietnam War.

mcqs.q: Was the communist world united during the Asian Cold War?
options: China and the USSR increasingly clashed in the Sino-Soviet split, so communism in Asia was far from a single coordinated bloc.
All communist states acted as one united bloc directed from Moscow.
China and the USA were allies throughout the Cold War.
The Korean War ended with the conquest of China.

mcqs.q: How did the Korean War end in 1953?
options: It ended in an armistice with the border near the original 38th parallel, leaving Korea divided rather than unified.
China conquered Vietnam in the war.
The Korean War ended with the conquest of China.
The Korean War ended with a clear communist or American victory.

The long conflict in which the USA backed South Vietnam against communist North Vietnam and the Viet Cong, ending in US withdrawal and communist victory.
